newsitem.title: USA: Ballot questions and bond referendums by state.
newsitem.headline: Ballot questions and bond referendums by state.

text.p: The following is a list of upcoming ballot initiatives and measures. The list will be updated as information is made available.
P - passed. D - defeated. NA - not available
--Pinellas County, 10-year extension of one-cent sales tax increase for schools.
--Broward County community of Bonaventure vote on whether to join City of Sunrise or City of Weston.
--DeKalb County vote on one-cent sales tax hike to offset rollback in property taxes.
--Spalding County vote on proposal to merge county and City of Griffin governments; one-cent sales tax hike for schools..
--City of Atlanta, one-cent sales tax hike for schools.
--City of Decatur, one-cent sales tax hike for schools.
--Clarke County, one-cent sales tax hike for schools
--Clayton County, one-cent sales tax hike for schools.
--Columbia County, one-cent sales tax hike for schools.
--DeKalb County, one-cent sales tax hike for schools.
--Douglas County, one-cent sales tax hike for schools.
--Fulton County, one-cent sales tax hike for schools.
--Gwinnett County, one-cent sales tax hike for scools.
--Jackson County, one-cent sales tax hike for schools
--Meriwether County, one-cent sales tax hike for schools.
--Paulding County, one-cent sales tax hike for schools.
--Pike County, one-cent sales tax hike for schools.
--Oglethorpe County, five-year extension of special purpose one-cent sales tax increase.
--Indian Prarie Community School District 204 (Naperville/Aurora) vote on $109.5 million general obligation bonds.
--Kansas City vote on $100 million of general obligation bonds.
--$2.335 million Haddon Heights, N.J., school bonds for renovations and equipment purchases.
--$1.527 million Haddon Heights, N.J., school bonds for construction projects to make schools comply with regulations requiring access for the disabled.
--$2.57 million Bergenfield bonds for school repairs.
--$3.9 million Mahwah school bonds for improvements to Ramapo Ridge Middle School.
--Newark votes on extending $11 million guarantee for $22 million Ironbound sportsplex project.
--$50 million Catawba County GO bonds for schools.
--$71.5 million City of High Point GO bonds for streets and recreation.
--$12.9 million Lexington County School District 3, GO bonds for schools.
--$61 million Lexington County School District 1, GO bonds for schools.
Houston votes on amending city charter on sales and property taxes.
--$89.6 million McKinney Independent School District, Texas, GO school construction and renovations.
--$2.5 million Callisburg Independent School District, Texas, G.O. school building bonds.
--$5.8 million Clifton Independent School District, Texas, G.O. school building bonds.
